enabled(address,uint256).notice: Whether only whitelisted takers may signal on the deposit.

groupRegistry().notice: Registry holding the groups a deposit can allow and their arbitrators.

isWhitelisted(address,uint256,address,by.notice: Whether the taker is on the deposit's whitelist: directly when groupId is zero, otherwise as a member of groupId, which the deposit must allow.

setEnabled(address,uint256,bool).notice: Turns the whitelist on, so only whitelisted takers may signal, or off.

setGroups(address,uint256,bytes32[],bool.notice: Allows or removes groups. Allowing a group accepts its arbitrator.

userdoc.notice: Per-deposit taker whitelist for OrchestratorV4. A taker is whitelisted directly or as a member of a group it names; when the whitelist is enabled, only whitelisted takers may signal. Allowing a group accepts its arbitrator for intents signaled through it.
